transcript.answer:
## Interest in astronomy: Czech vs Polish Wikipedia

**Polish (Astronomia)**: No clear trend. Pageviews fell 9.6% over the last 12 months [90% range −23.8% to +8.8%], averaging 1,198 views/month. The range includes zero, so there's no statistically clear change — it's flat. Polish Wikipedia has a much larger astronomy audience.

**Czech (Astronomie)**: Declining. Pageviews fell 22.9% over the last 12 months [90% range −31.6% to −11.2%], averaging 538 views/month. High confidence: 10 of 12 months showed fewer views than the same months a year earlier. The Czech audience is smaller and shrinking.

**Comparison**: The two editions are 13.2 percentage points apart, but with a 90% range that includes zero, so there's no clear statistical difference in their trajectories — both are flat to declining.

**Seasonal note**: Both editions peak in September (Polish +47.8%, Czech +22.8% above their annual averages), suggesting increased interest around the northern-hemisphere fall/school season.

**Caveats**: Pageviews measure attention on Wikipedia, not broader demand for astronomy education or content. Wikimedia also reclassified bot traffic in 2025, which slightly affects the figures.
